name: japan-da-man
description: japan-da-man's Claude Code plugins and mods

plugins.name: japan-da-man-mods
plugins.description: [bundle] Installs every japan-da-man plugin at once: todo-mod, token-weather, usage-stats, blast-radius, replay-theater and mod-dev

plugins.name: todo-mod
plugins.description: [mod] TODO pane: check a task to have Claude run it

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: [mod] Shows how full the context window is as a weather forecast above the prompt

plugins.name: usage-stats
plugins.description: [mod] Usage stats pane: sessions, messages, tokens, active days, streak, favorite model and a daily heatmap

plugins.name: mod-dev
plugins.description: [skills] Skills for building Claude Code mods: scaffold, test and register a new mod in a plugin marketplace repo or on its own

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: [mod] Catches risky shell commands (rm -rf, find -delete, xargs rm, git reset --hard, force push, git clean, discarding changes), including inside bash -c and eval, before they run, shows what they would touch in a side pane, and asks before running them

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: [mod] Records every file edit Claude makes in a turn; /replay or r steps through the diffs one at a time in a docked pane
